info.name: Histae API Rust
info.description: Collection based on docs/http-contract.md (103 routes). Import it into Postman, set baseUrl to http://SERVER_IP:API_PORT for access from your local network, then fill in the variables. Mobile flow: OTP send, OTP verify, consents, profile. OTP verify and refresh responses populate accessToken and refreshToken. Admin sessions use adminCookie (the full “name=value” value) and adminOrigin; signing in requires a real WebAuthn proof. Webhooks require valid signatures. Requests marked ⚠️ have real effects: do not run the entire collection with Collection Runner. Do not export the collection after testing if it contains tokens. Full contract: docs/http-contract.md.

{ phone_number } + idempotency key → 202 { message }.

Postman generates a new UUID v4 for each new send. If the first send was accepted, replaying the same key does not send another SMS. On 503 otp_delivery_unknown, do not retry with a new key: wait, then replay with the original key shown in the Postman Console.
{ phone_number, otp } → 200 { access_token, refresh_token }.
{ refresh_token } → 200 { access_token, refresh_token }.

Raw JSON body + Stripe-Signature → 200 { received: true }.

The signature must match the exact raw body. Use an event signed by Stripe; the placeholder returns 401.

Raw JSON body + webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature → 200 { received: true }.

HMAC signature over id.timestamp.raw-body. Use a signed Sweego callback; the placeholders return 401.
